input.command: cd /workspace && find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | head -60 && echo "=== dotenv ===" && ls -la dotenv tests
cd /workspace && cat dotenv/variables.py && echo "=== MAIN ===" && cat dotenv/main.py
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -30
cd /workspace && grep -n "str(\|resolve\|None" dotenv/variables.py dotenv/cli.py dotenv/ipython.py dotenv/__init__.py | head -40

rm -rf /tmp/probe && cp -r /workspace /tmp/probe && cd /tmp/probe && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='dotenv/variables.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''        result = env.get(self.name, default)
        return str(result)''','''        result = env.get(self.name, default)
        if result is None:
            return ""
        return result''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /tmp/probe && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -6
cd /workspace; grep -rn "None" tests/test_acceptance.py | head -40; echo ---; sed -n '1,200p' tests/test_acceptance.py

cd /workspace; python - <<'EOF'
from dotenv.variables import Variable, parse_variables
from dotenv.main import resolve_variables
import os

# 1) 直接命中 Variable.resolve
print("direct:", repr(Variable("X", "fallback").resolve({"X": None})))
print("typed :", repr(Variable("X", None).resolve({"X": None})))

# 2) 普通值
for env in ({"X": "value"}, {}, {"X": ""}):
    print("normal:", env, "->", repr(Variable("X", "fallback").resolve(env)))

# 3) 经由 resolve_variables：KEY（无=）产生 None，被后续 ${KEY} 引用
result = resolve_variables([("A", "one"), ("EMPTY", None), ("B", "pre-${EMPTY}-post")], override=True)
print("resolve_variables:", result)
EOF
cd /workspace; python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -30
